services.name: Group Lessons
services.desc: Learning to swim is more than a skill - it’s a lifelong gift. At our historic hot springs, we blend safety, fun, and expertise to help all ages and skills master the water. Led by Swimwell-certified instructors, our lessons take place in the world’s largest hot springs pool. For swimmers just getting started, there’s no better place to learn than here. Everyone deserves to feel safe and confident in the water. Swimming lessons reduce water-related risk and develop life-saving skills. Build strength, independence, and love for the water with private, semi-private, and group lesson options. Just visiting the resort for a few days? services.name: Day Passes
services.desc: Select one of our pool passes to enjoy the benefits of the largest hot springs pool all year long. Love the healing waters of our hot springs pools and just can’t get enough? Is soaking in our mineral springs a daily or weekly routine for you and your family? Our single, partner, and family passes offer great value for local residents and visitors to the pool who frequent the resort starting at 10 or more times per year. Annual and Value Season pass holders also enjoy 10% off at The Shop at Glenwood Hot Springs Resort. services.name: Vapor Cave Spa Package
services.desc: Pair your experience at Glenwood Hot Springs Pools with a visit to Yampah Spa and Vapor Caves. Enjoy an 80 minute full-body massage and access to the underground Vapor Caves, just one block away from our property. The Vapor Cave Spa Package is exclusively available for guests of Hotel 1888. Review additional information from our partner, Yampah Spa and Vapor Caves. One 80 minute massage per guest with two hours of cave access at Yampah Spa and Vapor Caves. Our helpful staff will be in touch to coordinate your Spa appointment. Valid for new reservations only. This package is available for Hotel 1888 reservations through December 31, 2026. services.name: Bike rental
services.desc: Get ready for eco-friendly exploration! The Hanging Lake Adventure Co-op (Glenwood Canyon Bikes) has the largest and newest fleet of E-Bikes in Glenwood Springs. You’ll have endless options of exploration & beautiful scenic views on 2 outstanding bike paths and over 50 miles to travel. Explore the Roaring Fork Valley from Glenwood Springs to Aspen on the Rio Grande trail. Or travel along the Colorado River on the Glenwood Canyon Bike Path and experience the pristine views of the Rocky Mountains and the Colorado River.
